question: What is the name of the helpline launched by NCPCR in May 2021 to provide psycho-social support to children affected during the COVID-19 pandemic?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Condolence**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The helpline named **Condolence** was launched by the National Commission for Protection of Child Rights (NCPCR) in May 2021.
 
• It was specifically designed to provide psycho-social support to children who were affected during the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• The helpline aims to address the mental health issues faced by children and provide necessary counselling and support.
 
• This initiative was part of the broader efforts by the government and child welfare organizations to mitigate the adverse effects of the pandemic on children.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Commission for Protection of Child Rights (NCPCR)**

 
 
• The NCPCR is a statutory body established by an Act of Parliament, the Commission for Protection of Child Rights Act, 2005.
 
• Its mandate is to ensure that all laws, policies, programs, and administrative mechanisms are in consonance with the child rights perspective as enshrined in the Constitution of India and the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child.
 
• The NCPCR focuses on the protection of child rights and the promotion of the best interests of children.
 
• It also monitors the implementation of various child-related policies and schemes.
 
 
 
• **Psycho-social Support**
 
 
• Psycho-social support refers to the support provided to individuals, especially children, to address their psychological and social needs.
 
• It includes counselling, emotional support, social interaction, and community support to enhance mental well-being.
 
• During the COVID-19 pandemic, many children faced isolation, anxiety, and stress due to the disruption of their normal routines and social interactions.
 
• Psycho-social support aims to help them cope with these challenges and promote their mental health.
 
 
 
• **COVID-19 Pandemic and Children**
 
 
• The COVID-19 pandemic had a significant impact on children worldwide, affecting their education, mental health, and overall well-being.
 
• School closures, social distancing measures, and lockdowns disrupted the daily lives of children, leading to increased stress and anxiety.
 
• Many children also faced the loss of family members, financial hardships, and lack of access to essential services.
 
• Efforts were made globally to provide support and resources to mitigate the adverse effects of the pandemic on children.
